@andrewlewis can you please check this or provide some pointers to where to look at ? 

Thanks in advance.

@ojw28  @andrewlewis We are facing this issue on the production app. Can someone please help us to fix this issue? 

Thanks.

Sorry for the delay getting to this. I added this sample to the demo app samples list:

```
{
  "name": "Issue #8456",
  "uri": "https://bitdash-a.akamaihd.net/content/sintel/hls/playlist.m3u8",
  "ad_tag_uri": "https://pubads.g.doubleclick.net/gampad/ads?sz=640x480&iu=/124319096/external/ad_rule_samples&ciu_szs=300x250&ad_rule=1&impl=s&gdfp_req=1&env=vp&output=vmap&unviewed_position_start=1&cust_params=deployment%3Ddevsite%26sample_ar%3Dpremidpostoptimizedpodbumper&cmsid=496&vid=short_onecue&correlator=",

  "subtitle_language": "en"

```

... replicating the "MIDROLL test" item from the patch in the linked archive, but it played correctly in the demo app using the latest `dev-v2` version. Please could you try doing the same and checking whether the ad UI shows for you? Note: I didn't apply the cookie-related parts of the patch but I'm not sure how those could be related.

Thanks for the reply @andrewlewis 

Have you checked the video I attached to repro the issue ?
We have to select side loaded subtitles from text tracks. I was able to reproduce 100% on 2.12.2 & 2.12.3

Cookie is not related to this issue :)

I'll check on dev branch and let you know. Thanks.

@andrewlewis I am able to reproduce on dev-v2 branch as well. Repro rate is 100%

Let me know if you need more details. 
Make sure you select the side loaded subtitle is selected before mid roll hits.
And let the ad play as user is watching. Do not seek.
@andrewlewis were you able to reproduce this ??

@andrewlewis I've done some debugging, when side-loaded subtitle is enabled, 
`renderer.isEnded()` is always return false for text track causing this issue. I'm not able to figure out why is this happening.
